# Exchange fixtures

These public BTCUSDT payloads were captured anonymously on 2026-07-28:

- Binance: one JSON trade from `btcusdt@trade`
- MEXC: one Base64-encoded binary frame from
  `spot@public.aggre.deals.v3.api.pb@100ms@BTCUSDT`

Tests decode them offline. They are data-contract examples, not price assertions.
